templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many hundredths are there in {x}?
templates.hint: Each whole is 100 hundredths.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Which of these is the largest: {a}, {b} or {c}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {a} + {b}?
templates.hint: Line up the decimal points.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {a} − {b}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: True or false: {d} is a factor of {n}.
templates.hint: A factor divides in with nothing left over.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: True or false: {n} is divisible by {d}.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is the highest common factor of {a} and {b}?
templates.hint: The largest number that divides into both.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is the lowest common multiple of {a} and {b}?
templates.hint: Count in {a}s and in {b}s until the lists meet.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: {a}/{d} + {b}/{d} = ?/{d}  What is the missing numerator?
templates.hint: The denominators match, so just add the numerators.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: {a}/{d} + {b}/{d * 2} = ?/{d * 2}  What is the missing numerator?
templates.hint: {a}/{d} is the same as {a * 2}/{d * 2}.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {n}/{d} of {total}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How much of this shape is shaded, in its simplest form?
templates.hint: Count the shaded parts and the parts altogether, then look for a smaller fraction that means the same.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {p}% of {total}?
templates.hint: 10% is one tenth; 25% is one quarter.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What percentage is the same as 1/{d}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: {p}% of a class has arrived. What percentage is still to come?
templates.hint: 100% is the whole class.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What percentage is the arrow pointing to?
templates.hint: The whole line is 100%.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {x} × {y}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {x} × {y}?
templates.hint: Split both numbers into tens and ones.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is {total} ÷ {d}?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is the remainder when {total} is divided by {d}?
templates.hint: How much is left over after the last whole group?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: {total} students are put into teams of {d}. How many full teams are there?
templates.hint: The leftover students do not make a full team.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: You know that {a} × {b} = {a * b}. What is {a * b} ÷ {b}?
templates.hint: Multiplying and dividing undo each other.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What goes in the box? {a} × ? = {product}

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: The rule is: multiply by {k}. Starting at {a}, what is the 4th number in the pattern?
templates.hint: {a} is the 1st number, so multiply by {k} three more times.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many millimetres are there in {n} centimetres?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many millilitres are there in {n} litres?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A parcel weighs {kg} kilograms. How many grams is that?
templates.hint: One kilogram is 1000 grams, so a tenth of a kilogram is 100.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A bottle holds {ml} millilitres. How many litres is that?
templates.hint: One litre is 1000 millilitres.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A {l} litre bottle has {ml} millilitres in it. How many more millilitres would fill it?
templates.hint: The full bottle holds {l * 1000} millilitres.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A rectangle is {l} cm long and {w} cm wide. What is its area, in square centimetres?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A rectangle has an area of {area} square cm and is {w} cm wide. How long is it, in centimetres?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A train leaves at {h}:00 in 24-hour time. What is that hour on a 12-hour clock?
templates.hint: After midday, take 12 off the 24-hour time.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: This clock shows a pm time. What is it in 24-hour time?
templates.hint: Read the clock first, then add 12 to the hour.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: This clock shows a pm time. How many minutes until {th}:{tms}?
templates.hint: Count on round the face in 5s from the long hand.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many degrees are there in {n} right angles?
templates.hint: A right angle is 90 degrees.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Is an angle of {d} degrees acute, obtuse or reflex?
templates.hint: Under 90 is acute, between 90 and 180 is obtuse, over 180 is reflex.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Is this angle acute, obtuse or reflex?
templates.hint: The marked sweep is the angle - a reflex one goes more than half way round.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: About how many degrees is this angle?
templates.hint: A right angle is 90 degrees. Is this one bigger or smaller than that?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: True or false: turning this shape half way round would leave it looking exactly the same.
templates.answer: shape == 'square' || shape == 'rectangle' || shape == 'rhombus' || shape == 'parallelogram' || shape == 'hexagon' || shape == 'octagon'
templates.hint: Half a turn is the same as looking at it upside down.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: In one full turn, how many times does this shape look exactly the same as it does now?
templates.answer: shape == 'rectangle' || shape == 'rhombus' || shape == 'parallelogram' ? 2 : shape == 'equilateral' ? 3 : shape == 'square' ? 4 : shape == 'pentagon' ? 5 : shape == 'hexagon' ? 6 : shape == 'heptagon' ? 7 : 8
templates.hint: A regular shape matches once for every side. A rectangle, a rhombus and a parallelogram match twice.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many edges does this shape have?
templates.hint: Count the edges you can see, then the dashed ones round the back.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many corners does this shape have?
templates.hint: One corner is hidden behind the shape. Count that one too.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: True or false: this shape has a face shaped like a square.
templates.hint: A rectangle is only a square when all four of its sides are the same length.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What are the coordinates of the dot?
templates.hint: The first number is how far along the bottom, the second is how far up.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Which point is one to the {ew} and one {ns} from the dot?
templates.hint: Find the point the dot is on, then move one line across and one line up or down.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Each picture stands for {k} books. How many more books did {a} read than {b}?
templates.hint: Count the pictures in both rows, then count on in {k}s.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: Each picture stands for 10 goals. How many goals did {who} score?
templates.hint: A whole picture is 10 goals and half a picture is 5.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many visitors came on {day}?
templates.hint: The numbers up the side go up in 10s. Find the day along the bottom and follow the line up.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many more visitors came on {b} than on {a}?
templates.hint: The numbers up the side go up in 10s. Read both days, then subtract.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: How many years are there between A and B?
templates.hint: Count the ticks from A to B. Each tick is worth 20 years.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: In what year did B happen?
templates.hint: Start at the year on the left and count on 20 for every tick.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is the chance the arrow stops on a shaded part?
templates.hint: Count the shaded parts, then all the parts.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: What is the chance of stopping on a shaded part, as a percentage?
templates.hint: The whole spinner is 100%. How much of it is shaded?

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: True or false: the arrow is equally likely to stop on any part.
templates.hint: Equally likely means every part is the same size.

templates.subject: maths
templates.prompt: A spinner stopped on red {r} times, blue {b} and green {g}. Which colour is it most likely to stop on?
templates.answer: r > b && r > g ? 'red' : b > g ? 'blue' : 'green'
templates.hint: The colour it stopped on most often is the one to expect next time.
